title: The elevator game gets a proper lobby
summary:
A community-heavy day: the elevator game gained a login screen, the app garden grew, and LTX-2 changed backends.

The Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge added an in-app login screen, a profile menu showing account details and Pollen balance, and a five-floor shaft display. Logout now returns players to login. The game also improved its sign-in flow, character conversations, response parsing, and animation sizing.

The community catalog added Puzzel Math, SciVis AI, ItacaLab, ContentAI, and several other submitted apps across learning, images, and writing. A metrics refresh put the Greenhouse at 680 listed apps.

The LTX-2 video pipeline moved to a GH200 backend with updated job handling. The model registry now marks LTX-2 as alpha.

highlights.title: An elevator game lobby
highlights.text: The Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge added an in-app login screen, a profile menu with your Pollen balance, and a five-floor shaft display. Logging out takes you back to the login screen.
